'''Fireworks (Green)''' are an item that can be purchased from [[Qi's Walnut Room]] for {{Price|1|Gem}} or from the [[Casino]] for {{Price|200|Qi}}. When used, the firework is placed on the ground. After a short delay, it goes into the air and creates green sparkles in the shape of a Junimo. The player's screen is also briefly tinted green. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus }} ==Bundles== Fireworks (Green) are not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Fireworks (Green) can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Party Hat (green)|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Fireworks (Green) are not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.5|Existed in the game's code, but unobtainable.}} {{History|1.6|Officially introduced in game.}} [[Category:Special items]] [[de:Feuerwerk (Grün)]] [[es:Fuegos artificiales (verde)]] [[fr:Feux d'artifice (Vert)]] [[it:Fuochi d'artificio (Verdi)]] [[ja:花火（緑）]] [[ko:폭죽 (초록)]] [[hu:Tűzijáték (Zöld)]] [[pt:Fogos de Artifício (Verde)]] [[ru:Фейерверк (Зеленый)]] [[tr:Yeşil Havaifişek]] [[zh:烟花（绿色）]]
